annotations.title: Who changed what on a Meta ad account

description: The change log of a Meta ad account, newest first: who created, edited, paused or re-budgeted which campaign, ad set or ad, when, from which app, with the value before and after. Use it for "what changed before performance dropped". since / until (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO) narrow the window; objectId keeps one campaign, ad set or ad (Meta has no per-object filter here, so it filters each page; pass after to go further back). Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared

objectId.description: only this campaign, ad set or ad
